## 简体中文

### 截图快捷键

- macOS 截图快捷键改为 Carbon 全局快捷键，不再依赖“辅助功能”或“输入监控”权限，App 在前台和后台都可触发。
- 快捷键只在提示板打开期间占用；关闭所有提示板后立即释放，避免影响其他 App 的“另存为”等操作。
- 增加快捷键冲突检测、无缝重新注册和提示板替换时的生命周期保护；设置中修改组合后立即生效。
- Windows 截图快捷键迁移到独立消息窗口，并在提示板和 Director Mode 中保持一致。

### 屏幕共享与提示板

- Windows 截图选区、图片预览和提示板弹出菜单现在会从屏幕捕获中隐藏。
- 改进不支持原生捕获排除时的兼容模式，保留提示板透明度、圆角和交互体验。
- 面试期间隐藏主窗口任务栏入口，并在提示板显示时重新应用捕获排除。
- 修复提示板菜单鼠标指针和菜单项行为。

### 稳定性

- Windows 增加启动阶段、后台线程崩溃和捕获排除诊断日志。
- 修复提示板替换、连续开关和快捷键重新注册之间的竞态。

## English

### Screenshot hotkeys

- The macOS screenshot shortcut now uses a Carbon global hotkey, requiring neither Accessibility nor Input Monitoring permission and working while the app is foreground or background.
- The shortcut is held only while a prompter is open and is released after the last prompter closes, restoring shortcuts such as Save As in other apps.
- Added conflict detection, seamless re-registration and lifecycle protection while replacing prompters; changes made in Settings take effect immediately.
- The Windows screenshot shortcut now uses a dedicated message-only window and works consistently in interview and Director Mode boards.

### Screen sharing and prompters

- Windows screenshot selectors, image previews and prompter pop-up menus are now excluded from capture.
- Improved compatibility mode on systems that cannot use native capture exclusion while preserving transparency, rounded corners and interaction.
- The main-window taskbar entry stays hidden during interviews, and capture exclusion is reapplied whenever the prompter appears.
- Fixed pointer and menu-item behavior in prompter menus.

### Reliability

- Added Windows startup checkpoints, background-thread crash logging and capture-exclusion diagnostics.
- Fixed races between prompter replacement, repeated open/close cycles and hotkey registration.
